notes: PARTIAL-CONTENT FILE - READ FIRST: this is a genuine SSC CBE response-sheet export ('challenge module' save) for the exact date+shift (header Test Date 12 Sep 2025, 09:00 AM Shift-1), but the source PDF is longer than the 30-page parse limit available in this environment: only PART-A (General Intelligence and Reasoning, Q1-25), PART-B (General Awareness, Q26-50) and the first PART-C (Quantitative Aptitude) question stem (Q51) are in the parsed layer; Q52-75 (Quant) and Q76-100 (English) are ABSENT from the parsed layer and are marked [NOT RECOVERABLE] - they have NOT been invented, completed or paraphrased. Within the recovered range: Q15, Q16, Q31, Q34, Q35, Q46, Q48 have empty question bodies in the parsed layer; Q10, Q30, Q47, Q49 have missing stems (partly recovered); Q9, Q36, Q47 have fewer than 4 options in the parsed layer. SECTIONS/NUMBERING: this export numbers questions globally 1-100 in the order PART-A GI&R (1-25), PART-B General Awareness (26-50), PART-C Quantitative Aptitude (51-75), PART-D English (76-100) - the section labels and Q.No are from the export itself. ORDER CAVEAT (quoted above): the challenge-module export may reorder questions and options relative to the live exam screen; the candidate's answer selections are preserved. This file therefore does NOT guarantee the live screen's question/option order. BILINGUAL SOURCE: every question in the source is bilingual (English + Hindi; some in Bengali); only the English layer was transcribed here (the Hindi/Bengali layers are largely garbled in the parsed text and are noted verbatim only where the English layer was missing - Q10 option 1, Q30 stem). SSC QUESTION IDs: not present in this export class; question_id is null throughout. CANDIDATE RESPONSES: only the 'Not Answered' status was recoverable as text (Q29, Q30, Q31, Q34, Q37, Q45); answered-question status markers ('Correct Option selected'/'Wrong Option selected') are rendered as graphics and were NOT recovered, so no candidate choice is recorded. ANSWERS: the export's legend implies per-question correct/incorrect marking, but the actual correct-option identity is not present in the recovered text layer for any question, and the official CGL 2025 tentative answer key (SSC, October 2025) is downloadable only by logged-in candidates; no machine-accessible official key was found in this environment - so every correct_answer here is null and answer_source null.
